function getBridgeRequest(bytes32 requestId) view returns (address user, uint256 amount, uint256 timestamp, uint256 nonce, bool processed, uint8 direction)
function getBridgeStats() view returns (uint256 toPolygon, uint256 fromPolygon, uint256 requests, bool active)
function getBridgeConfig() view returns (uint256 min, uint256 max, uint256 dailyLimit, uint256 delay, uint256 feeRate)
event BridgeToPolygon(address indexed user, uint256 amount, uint256 fee, bytes32 indexed requestId, uint256 nonce)
event BridgeFromPolygon(address indexed user, uint256 amount, bytes32 indexed requestId, bytes32 indexed polygonTxHash)
